statement: What number is made of 4 tens and 12 ones?

choices.misconception: I added 4 and 12 as if they were all ones.
I wrote the 4 tens and kept only the 2 from the 12 ones.
I treated the 12 as tens too, so I had 16 tens.
I wrote the 4 and then the 12 next to each other.

hints: Can 12 ones all fit in the ones place?
Ten ones make one ten. Turn as many of the 12 ones as you can into a ten, then count the tens and the ones that are left.
12 ones are 1 ten and 2 ones. Add that ten to the 4 tens you already have.

solutions.reliable: 4 tens are 40 and 12 ones are 12, so the number is 40 + 12 = 52. Another way: 12 ones are 1 ten and 2 ones, so there are 5 tens and 2 ones, which is 52. The idea to keep: ten ones always make one more ten.

whyOnTest: Place value means knowing that ten ones make a ten, and a number with more than 9 ones checks that a student regroups instead of writing digits side by side.
author: Devansh Sanghavi
